commentary: With the Nifty reclaiming 25,250 and market breadth registering a constructive 58% expansion, market direction leans supportive under O'Neil's confirmed uptrend framework. Institutional inflows are reviving, but selective post-earnings divergences demand stringent stock picking. As Weinstein warned, broad index gains often mask internal deterioration; hence, exposure must be earned via progressive commitments in genuine Stage 2 leaders rather than chasing low-quality setups. We demand authentic EPS and sales acceleration (CANSLIM C-and-A criteria) alongside tight volatility contraction (VCP). Non-equity instruments and fundamental laggards are disqualified, preserving capital for high-momentum pivots.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

360ONE.technical: Clearing a 20-session high on 1.98× volume confirms constructive demand above rising key moving averages. The pattern displays healthy Stage 2 accumulation with RSI at 67, though price action requires tight consolidation above the pivot to prevent false breakouts.
360ONE.fundamental: While wealth management ARR remains robust and operating revenue expanded 17.5% YoY, net earnings contracted 5.5% YoY in Q2 FY27 due to mark-to-market fluctuations. Return on equity stands near 15%, but the lack of true 25%+ bottom-line CANSLIM acceleration precludes leadership status.
360ONE.risk: Failure below the 1146.64 swing stop invalidates the breakout; cut losses immediately if selling volume expands below the 20-day average.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: A double bottom setup has developed above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA with volume contracting on pullbacks. However, breakout follow-through lacks institutional sponsorship, and the micro-cap liquidity profile presents severe slippage hazards.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Operating metrics deteriorated sharply in Q1 FY27 with revenue plunging 55.3% YoY and net profit dropping 25.4%. Low margins of 1.5% to 3.0% and an ROE below 4% fail O'Neil's basic CANSLIM profitability criteria, leaving the balance sheet vulnerable.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Thesis fails decisively on a violation of the 104.66 pivot low; exit immediately as illiquid micro-caps can gap down sharply.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Constructive double bottom with neckline pressure above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. Relative strength is surging with RSI at 69 and volume expanding on up-days, characteristic of institutional accumulation in early Stage 2.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Outstanding CANSLIM characteristics with Q2 FY27 net profit surging 156% YoY on 45.9% revenue growth, following triple-digit profit growth in Q1. Operating margins expanded toward 17% with manageable leverage and healthy ROCE, confirming genuine fundamental leadership in specialty pharma.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Breach below 914.25 support ruins the base structure; execute an unconditional stop to cap maximum portfolio drawdown.

AARVI.technical: Clean 20-day high breakout on exceptional 3.08× volume expansion, aligning with Darvas and Minervini pivot criteria. Price rides comfortably above rising moving averages, exhibiting solid relative strength within technical staffing.
AARVI.fundamental: Net profit grew 41.9% YoY in Q1 FY27 after 44.7% growth in Q4 FY26, satisfying EPS acceleration rules. Revenue growth at 14.1% sits just shy of the 15% CANSLIM threshold. Low debt-to-equity of 0.19 and double-digit ROCE offer defensive stability.
AARVI.risk: A close below the 145.61 risk pivot voids the momentum impulse; enforce strict stop discipline without averaging down.

ABDL.technical: Developing double bottom formation above the key moving averages with volume drying up during consolidation. RSI at 63 and positive MACD show stabilizing momentum, but heavy overhead supply near recent highs still tests buyers.
ABDL.fundamental: Revenue grew 15.9% YoY in Q2 FY27, but net profit rose only 9.7% while H1 FY27 net profit fell 3.6% YoY. High valuation multiples and sub-15% bottom-line expansion violate core CANSLIM acceleration criteria, capping institutional interest.
ABDL.risk: Exit if the scrip falls below the 711.18 neckline support; failing to hold higher lows indicates pattern distribution.

ABGSEC.technical: The instrument is a sovereign debt exchange-traded fund tracking government securities rather than an operating business. Technical breakouts in gilt funds reflect macro interest rate shifts rather than equity momentum or VCP characteristics.
ABGSEC.risk: Trading an interest-rate-sensitive debt ETF under an equity growth framework introduces duration risk and structural mismatch; stop at 116.51.
